ideas.title: The Web of Child Care Fraud: Uncovering Minnesota's Feeding Our Future Scheme
ideas.description: Investigate the connections between alleged child care fraud in Minnesota and the larger Feeding Our Future COVID relief scheme.
ideas.angle: Follow the money: tracing the flow of funds in the alleged child care fraud scheme
questions: How did the alleged fraud occur?
Who was involved in the scheme?
searches: Feeding Our Future COVID relief fraud
ideas.insight: The alleged child care fraud in Minnesota may be connected to a larger scheme involving COVID relief funds, potentially involving multiple entities and individuals.
